title: Govt Schemes, Student Grants & Subsidies 🏛️
description: NSP (National Scholarship Portal), PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme, Education Loan Subsidies, and Student Welfare schemes.

cards.title: PM Vidyalaxmi & CSIS Subsidies 🎓
cards.content: CSIS (Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme): Family income < ₹4.5 LPA? **Moratorium period (Course + 1 year) ka poora loan interest Government pay karti hai!**
cards.imagePrompt: Government pillar building with graduation cap and scholarship document, cyan theme

choiceData.scenario: Education loan liya hai ₹5 LPA. CSIS subsidy eligible family income boundary?

choices.consequence: Wrong! Subsidy income capped at ₹4.5 LPA.

choices.text: Family income < ₹4.5 LPA — Apply via CSIS portal
choices.consequence: Success! Course tenure ka total interest Government cover karegi.

cards.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) 💻
cards.content: NSP Portal pe central/state scholarships: Post-Matric, Single Girl Child, Special merit grants worth ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000/year.
cards.imagePrompt: Laptop showing scholarship grant verification green checkmark

quizData.question: Govt scholarship application ke liye Aadhaar-bank account seeding zaroori hai?
options: Haan, DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) ke liye mandatory hai
quizData.explanation: DBT grants straight Aadhaar-linked bank account mein aate hain.

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: Scholarship & Subsidy Portal Audit
cards.content:
🚨 **TODAY'S MISSION**

Govt Subsidy Audit:

- [ ] National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) pe register karo.
- [ ] Bank account DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) status check karo.
- [ ] Income certificate valid format mein ready rakho.
- [ ] Category / Merit subsidy eligibility search karo.
cards.imagePrompt: Government stamp seal with green checkmark
